title: Abyss: Depths, bones and omens
summary: Push Abysses into Abyssal Depths with Depths-chance tablets and notables, make waystone mods apply down there with Close to the Surface, and sell the desecration currency and abyssal omens.

budget.build_needs: Clears Abyss pits whose monsters steal modifiers, and the Abyssal Depths below.

claim.note: Editorial estimate from what the setup needs; not measured.

yields.why: Listed among Abyss items; Vile Treasures can raise Omen finds.
Abyss desecration currency; Rotting Bones raises the chance of Ancient Desecrated Currency.
Abyss desecration currency for Rare Jewels.

nodes.name: Evolutionary Pressure
nodes.effect: 1% increased Rarity of Items Dropped by Monsters, 2% increased Effectiveness of Monsters and 3% increased chance of Monster Modifiers on Rare Monsters, each per Explicit Modifier on the Map

nodes.name: Improved Calibration
nodes.effect: Waystones have 25% more effect of Prefix Modifiers or 25% more effect of Suffix Modifiers when opening Maps

claim.note: Owner's notes pick Doryani for Abyss. Our reading: with Close to the Surface, waystone mods (which Improved Calibration strengthens) also apply in Abyssal Depths. Not measured.

atlas_passives.name: Close to the Surface
atlas_passives.effect: Explicit Modifiers on your Waystones apply to Abyssal Depths in the Map area; Abyss Tablets also grant Abyssal Depths 25% increased chance for Abyssal and for Lichborn Modifiers, and 4% increased Pack Size

atlas_passives.name: Vile Treasures
atlas_passives.effect: 50% increased chance to find Abyssal Items — choose Abyssal Eyes, Omens or Lineage Supports. Take Omens.

atlas_passives.name: Depths Chance
atlas_passives.effect: Abysses have 10% increased chance to lead to an Abyssal Depths (a small node the tree repeats)

atlas_passives.name: Unholy Influence
atlas_passives.effect: 100% increased chance for Abyssal monsters to have Abyssal Modifiers and 100% for Lichborn Modifiers

atlas_passives.name: Rotting Bones
atlas_passives.effect: 25% increased chance to find Ancient Desecrated Currency

atlas_passives.name: Abyssal Ire
atlas_passives.effect: 25% chance for Abyssal Depths in Level 78+ Areas to contain a Boss; 25% chance for an Ulaman pit near the Map Boss to have the Incubator Queen

mods.text: Abysses in Map have (10–20)% increased chance to lead to an Abyssal Depths
(20–30)% increased chance for Abyssal monsters in Map to have Abyssal Modifiers
Map has (25–35)% increased number of Rare Monsters
Abyss Pits in Map are twice as likely to have Rewards

waystone.notes: Owner's order. Close to the Surface makes these waystone mods apply inside Abyssal Depths as well.

claim.note: Owner's run notes plus the Close to the Surface text; not measured.

steps: Allocate Close to the Surface, Vile Treasures (Omens), Rotting Bones and the Depths Chance nodes.
Set Doryani: Evolutionary Pressure and Improved Calibration.
Slot an Abyss Tablet with Depths chance and Abyssal-modifier chance; effectiveness and rare-monster mods second.
Close every pit; the final Abyss can open an Abyssal Depths — always take it.
risks: 0.5.5: the 'of Champions' Abyss tablet mod now spawns 2–3 extra rares (was 1–2) — harder pits.
No source gives omen or bone drop rates; the basket prices single items only.
0.5.5 added Large Abyssal Ravines, whose maps always contain Abysses.
